name: Double Barrel Creek
description:
SUNDAY 31 January
 
REGISTRATION WITH THE WALK LEADER IS ESSENTIAL. PLEASE READ THE INFORMATION BELOW.
 
RATED - Hard
Although this should be a relatively flat walk (except for track walk home from Crystal Creek Falls) expect off track walking, slippery rocks, creek crossings/creek walking, thick rainforest etc.
 
DESCRIPTION
A major part of this adventure is off-track rainforest and creek walking down Double Barrel Creek to Blue Lagoon then Crystal Creek Falls. 
This is an explorative walk. We'll start on track from the dam (1hr). From there we'll head to the headwaters of Double Barrel Creek, then walk down the creek - either along side in rainforest, or in the creek itself (probably both). On reaching Crystal Creek junction, it'll be a short walk downstream to Blue Lagoon for a swim. After that, it's a short stroll through rainforest and cascades to Crystal Creek Falls. Heading home will be back on track for the 1.5 hr walk uphill back to the dam. Along the way there may be tangled vines to negotiate - love the rainforest!
 
WHAT TO BRING
 - Water: minimum 2L (refill from the creek or bring 4L - see below**). Electrolytes.
 - Clothing:  Long sleeves and pants/gaiters recommended. As this walk if off track the likelihood if getting scratched etc is high. Many members also wear fingerless gloves.
 - Enclosed footwear that will get wet. Leather boots not recommended.
 - Food for the day
 - Hat, sunscreen and insect repellent
 - Usual bushwalking gear 
 - Personal first aid kit including a compression bandage and blister kit is recommended.
- Walking poles (optional). These can provide assistance with creek crossing and creek walking (ie for balance) or on track  but can be a hinderance when walking off track.
 
** Water: if you are uncomfortable using creek water for drinking water refill (after treating suitably), then carry 4 lt min for the day, or more to suit your requirements. Note that the club recommends that any natural water sources must be suitably treated before consumption.

COST
 Non members = $5 walk fee for insurance
 Must be over 18years to participate
 
WALK LEADER, INFO and REGISTRATION
 Walk leader is Luen
 To discuss suitability, to register or for more information please contact luenwarneke@gmail.com.
 
 WALK DETAILS
 Meet time: Paluma Village Green at 0800 (cnr Mt Spec Rd and Smith Cres, adjacent to the Community Centre)
 Return time: back at cars at Paluma Dam by 5pm
 
 Please note:
 To protect the privacy of club officials, walk leaders, property owners or sensitive areas, contact details and some locations won't be published on Facebook or website or be given out via private message. Please contact the club via email and we will respond ASAP. 
 
 On some activities, walker numbers may be limited to promote the safety and enjoyment of all, due to location size and ability to socially distance or to reduce our environmental impact at some locations.
 
 COVID-19
 Please do not attend if you are unwell, have symptoms or meet any conditions imposed as per Qld Government. Social distancing and self managed hygiene practices are strongly encouraged, and the club will not be organising car pooling opportunities at present. The club is cognisant of the Outdoors Queensland COVID SAFE PLAN for Outdoor Recreation Providers. On some walks, as noted above, numbers may be limited.
 
 We hope to see you on a walk soon.

- Enclosed sturdy footwear
- Food for the day
- Hat, sunscreen and insect repellent (definitely bring the insect repellent!!)
- Personal first aid kit including a compression bandage and blister kit is recommended.

name: Dolby Creek - off track exploration
description:
On Saturday 23rd January we’ll head to Dolby Creek in the Mt Spec area. This walk will be an off-track rainforest creek exploration. 

REGISTRATION IS ESSENTIAL

Type of walk:
full day exploration bushwalking. Walk will be around 20 km. Track at start and end of day – but from about 10 am to 2 pm will be several hours off-track exploring Dolby Creek (Johnstone’s Clearing area) walking through rainforest, viewing lovely creek scenery. We will look for historic hut and tin mining sites from circa 1920s, and may also bushwalk along Crystal Creek to DCK Hut. Very photogenic creek areas.
 
Cost:
non-members $5 fee. 
 
What you need:
- Carry water (minimum 2 lt), refill from creek as required (treat / filter your water refill) . 
- Lunch, snacks / energy food, electrolytes
- Hat, sunscreen, insect repellent (leeches, mozzies)
- Enclosed sturdy footwear (see note below)
- Personal first kit. 
- Recommend long sleeve clothing / gaiters to avoid scratches. 
- Some members also wear fingerless gloves. Hiking poles are good on track walks.  
(If you are uncomfortable using creek water for drinking water refill (after treating suitably), then carry 4 lt min for the day, or more to suit your requirements. Note that the club recommends that any natural water sources must be suitably treated before consumption).
 
Note – footwear will get wet, so wear foot wear that is suitable.  
 
Timing and meet:
Meet Paluma Village Green at the toilet block car park at 8 am. We then drive to the dam.
Estimated Completion – back at the dam car park around 5 pm. 
 
Must be over 18yrs to participate.
